message: HOLD — 2 critical error(s) found. Correct before shipping.

critical_errors.description: Specimen ID on the bottle must match the ID on the CCF. Mismatch = fatal flaw. This is the core of chain of custody.
critical_errors.check: Specimen ID numbers on bottle and CCF match
critical_errors.notes: Specimen ID on bottle is 12345, CCF shows 12346

critical_errors.description: Tamper-evident seal must be applied to the specimen bottle. Donor must initial and date the seal. This proves the specimen hasn't been opened since collection.
critical_errors.check: Specimen seal applied with donor initials and date
critical_errors.notes: Donor did not initial the seal
